svg.aria-label: How Payers earn. The Receiver deposits 100 dollars and the Payer 50. At 5 percent a year, the Receiver's 5 dollars of interest goes to the Payer, on top of the Payer's own 2 dollars 50. The Receiver stays at 100 dollars and the Payer grows to 57 dollars 50. Each dot is one dollar, each small dot 50 cents.
